question: Can the reusable usegit workflow run on repositories that require their own self-hosted runner instead of GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest?
hypothesis: Making the reusable runner label an explicit workflow input and using bash for run steps will preserve the same causal validation/evidence behavior on both ubuntu-latest and Windows self-hosted runners.

evidence.observation: Reusable workflow failed before its first step because ubuntu-latest was unavailable; job reported runner_id 0.
The self-hosted Windows runner started successfully, then failed at Configure evidence transport because bash is not installed as an Actions shell.
Runner-default PowerShell was selected on Windows but local execution policy blocks generated .ps1 scripts; the target repository already uses cmd successfully.
Dynamic shell expression prevented the reusable caller from constructing any job; shell selection must be static workflow topology.
